title: Bengaluru: gardens, craft beer and tech
summary: India's garden city and startup capital pairs leafy parks and pleasant weather all year with a famous craft brewery and cafe scene. Ideal for business trips that stretch into a relaxed weekend.

title: Delhi: monuments, markets and Mughal food
summary: Centuries of history in one city: Mughal tombs, forts and colonial avenues, plus legendary street food and sprawling bazaars. Winters are crisp and perfect for heritage walks.
highlights: Kebabs and chaat in Old Delhi

title: Mumbai: seafront city that never sleeps
summary: A coastal megacity of sea-facing promenades, colonial architecture, Bollywood and a nightlife that runs late. Street food and seafood are reasons to visit on their own.

title: Hyderabad: biryani, pearls and palaces
summary: Home of the famous biryani, the Charminar and grand Nizam-era palaces, with bustling pearl and bangle bazaars and a fast-growing tech district.
highlights: Golconda Fort sound and light show

title: Chennai: temples, music and the coast
summary: A cultural capital with one of the longest urban beaches in the world, ancient temples, Carnatic music and classical dance, and some of the best South Indian food anywhere.

title: Kolkata: literature, sweets and colonial grandeur
summary: The cultural heart of the east: colonial landmarks, book streets, adda over tea, Durga Puja festivities and an unmatched love of sweets and fish curry.
